places.name: Saltamonte T3 · Apto 106
places.notes:
Agency: A&B Inmobiliaria. Urbanización Saltamonte, lower Loma del Escobero, near City Plaza / Euro del Escobero / Hospital Uribe Angel. Estrato 5.

110 m2, 3 alcobas, 2 banos, TWO parking spaces, piso 1. Ground floor of the tower, but the building sits on the hillside, so the photos still show a LARGE brick-paved terrace with a full valley view. And no elevator wait every time the dog needs out. Sala-comedor, cocina integral WITH DISHWASHER, estudio, zona de ropas, master with ensuite + vestier. Wood laminate in the bedrooms, delivered empty and freshly painted.

Building: 24h security, visitor parking, salon social, pool, sauna, turco, elevator, gym, sports zone, playground, green areas, and PET ZONES.

CONFIRMED 15 Aug: 4.6M INCLUDES administracion, and dogs are allowed. 100k over the 4.5M cap, so effectively on budget. At 1609 m it is the LOWEST of the Escobero options, and Envigado centro is 918 m away at only 25 m below - the one genuinely flat walk on this board.

STILL ASK A&B: furnished or not, and the available date.

places.name: Loma del Indio · piso 22
places.notes:
5.000.000/mo ALL IN - confirmed 15 Aug that this includes administracion and that dogs are allowed. 500k over the 4.5M cap.

Big wraparound terrace with a real valley view, floor-to-ceiling sliders, proper zona de ropas (Bosch gas heater + sink), compact black-granite kitchen with gas cooktop, oven and a slatted island bar, master bath with double vanity. Interior is heavily styled: 3D geometric wallpaper, faux-stone accent wall, crystal chandeliers, mirrored wall.

98 m2 including a terrace that big leaves a tight interior for 3BR + 2BA.

WALKABILITY: better than it looks on paper. Cafes at 100 m, bus stop 157 m, Minimercado Espana 158 m, gyms ~180 m. But the real supermarkets (D1, Maxioferta, Mall El Indio) are ~350 m out and ~90 m DOWN, and Jumbo / Premium Plaza / Bodytech are ~940 m and ~145 m down. Hill-adjusted walkability 89 vs 97 flat - the biggest drop of the two originals.

Jordan called it a no-go on 15 Aug: needing a car defeats the point. Kept on the board rather than deleted, because the pin is barrio-level (±200 m) and the numbers do not actually show it as unwalkable - drop the exact pin and re-scan before writing it off.

places.name: El Escobero 9946
places.notes:
Seen 16 Aug. Spicol cod 9946, Loma del Escobero, Envigado. Estrato 5, built 2021, 2 linear parking spaces.

80 m2, 2 alcobas (both ensuite) + bano social = 3 banos, vestier, closet, sala-comedor, zona de ropas, cocina integral con gas, balcon, 1 cuarto util, 2 parqueaderos. Listing says SIN AMOBLAR, but the photos show it fully furnished - confirm which you'd be getting.

Building: pool, sauna, turco, gym, SQUASH, basketball court, synthetic pitch, BBQ, salon social, meeting rooms, kids area, elevator, 24h vigilancia, CCTV, motion sensors, visitor + moto parking. The best amenity set of anything you've seen.

THE PROBLEM IS THE LOCATION. This sits at 1744 m - 135 m higher than Saltamonte and 118 m higher than Loma del Indio, the highest of everything on this board. Only 13 things of any kind inside 1 km (Saltamonte has 81, Loma del Indio 84), and exactly ONE restaurant. Nearest grocery is City Plaza at 540 m with a 76 m climb home. Hill-adjusted walkability 36 vs Saltamonte's 90.

ASK: does 4.3M include administracion, pets, available date, furnished or not, and which floor.

BUILDING NAME UNKNOWN. Spicol never names the conjunto and OSM has no building here. Reverse geocoding the coordinates from their map embed gives Calle 37B Sur, barrio La Mina, Envigado 055420. You were at the gate - add the unidad name and the door number under Edit / rate.

SAME BUILDING AND SAME SPEC AS 9945 - the only stated difference is that this one's two parking spaces are linear (one behind the other) rather than independent.
